Reproducibility: Temperature and Sampling (Part 6)

A benchmark whose numbers move between runs has to explain the movement before its other claims deserve attention. Sampling temperature is the largest lever: at temperature zero most providers return the argmax token deterministically, while any positive temperature injects deliberate randomness. A quality evaluation that does not pin and disclose its temperature is measuring its own noise as much as the model.

Disclosure has to be structural, not a footnote. The report header should carry the inference settings that were frozen at run time: temperature, maximum output tokens, streaming on or off, and the grader set in effect. Freezing matters because a dataset edited after the run must not silently rewrite history; the snapshot taken at run start is the artifact the report describes.

Even at temperature zero, determinism is a gradient rather than a guarantee. Batching, speculative decoding, and provider-side scheduling can make two identical requests diverge, and a benchmark that treats a single run as ground truth will mistake that variance for signal. Reporting the run-to-run drift for a small fixed probe set tells the reader how much of the spread to believe.

Non-streaming is the safer default for quality runs. Streaming adds an implementation variable that has nothing to do with model quality, and some providers route streamed traffic differently. The performance suite wants streaming because users experience streams; the quality suite wants it off because graders want the complete text. Two suites, two defaults, both stated.

The last piece is environment disclosure. Model revision strings change without notice, so the harness should record the identifier the provider returns with each response. A quality report that cannot name the exact revision it measured will be unreadable in a year, and the failure is silent: the report still looks authoritative while describing a model that no longer exists.

Failure Semantics and Error Taxonomy (Part 6)

The credibility of a measurement tool is decided by what it does when things go wrong. A harness that fills failed requests with plausible-looking synthetic numbers produces beautiful reports that are quietly worthless; a harness that reports the failure honestly produces uglier reports that can be trusted. The design rule is absolute: a number in the report must trace back to a real request, or it must not exist.

Error taxonomy is what turns raw failures into information. Rate-limit responses, authentication rejections, malformed streams, context-length overflows, and server crashes are different events with different remedies, and a benchmark that buckets them all as unknown error forces the reader to guess. Classification should happen at the adapter layer, where the provider-specific shapes are known, and travel with the sample as a structured field.

The distinction between a failed request and an ungradeable answer is the second structural decision. A request that never completed produced no output to judge; a request that completed with nonsense produced output the grader rejected. Collapsing the two makes availability problems look like quality problems, and a pass-rate computed over that collapsed set answers a question nobody asked.

Aggregation policy follows from the taxonomy. Latency percentiles computed over successful requests only, error rate reported separately, and unscored items excluded from quality denominators: each population must be named in the report. Silent population switching, where the denominator shrinks without explanation, is the most common way honest measurements become dishonest reports.

Finally, stop conditions should be loud. A run that halted after the first failure must say so at the top of the report, because a truncated distribution presented without the truncation notice is indistinguishable from a complete one. The cheapest defense is a status line that states samples planned, samples completed, and the reason the run ended.

测量工具的可信度，是由它出错时的行为决定的。一个用看起来合理的合成数字填补失败请求的工具，会产出漂亮却悄悄一文不值的报告；一个如实报告失败的工具，产出的报告更难看，却可以信任。设计规则是绝对的：报告里的每个数字要么能追溯到一个真实请求，要么就不该存在。

错误分类是把原始失败变成信息的手段。限流响应、鉴权拒绝、流格式损坏、上下文长度溢出、服务端崩溃，是不同的事件、有不同的对策；把它们统统归进"未知错误"的基准，等于逼读者去猜。分类应当在适配器层完成——那里最清楚各供应商的错误形态——并作为结构化字段随样本一起传递。

"请求失败"与"答案无法判分"的区分，是第二个结构性决定。一个从未完成的请求没有产出可供评判；一个完成了但输出胡言乱语的请求，产出了被判分器拒绝的答案。把两者混为一谈，会让可用性问题看起来像质量问题，而在混合集合上算出的通过率，回答的是一个没有人问过的问题。

聚合策略从分类中自然推出。延迟分位数只对成功请求计算、错误率单独报告、未能判定的条目排除在质量分母之外：每一处统计口径都必须在报告里点明。口径的静默切换——分母在没有解释的情况下变小——是诚实的测量变成不诚实的报告最常见的路径。

Long-Context Behavior and Attention (Part 6)

Context windows are advertised as hard numbers, but quality degrades gradually inside the window rather than failing at its edge. Retrieval accuracy for a fact buried in the middle of a long prompt is typically worse than for the same fact at the beginning or end, a pattern strong enough to have a name. Benchmarking long-context behavior therefore requires probes that vary position deliberately, not just length.

Multi-document prompts are the practical carrier for these probes. A prompt built from independent documents with a per-document task at the end lets the harness score each document separately: which positions were retrieved, which were skipped, and whether the boundary between documents confused the segmentation. The same prompt shape doubles as a realistic load for latency and cost measurement, since production prompts rarely consist of one homogeneous blob.

Output scope control belongs in the harness, not the prompt author hands. Asking a model to summarize two hundred thousand tokens into three bullets produces a cheap response; asking it to list every document produces a long one. Letting the same prompt template carry an adjustable scope instruction separates the cost of input processing from the cost of output generation, which is exactly the split a capacity planner needs.

Token counting for long inputs is where local estimation diverges most from provider accounting. Special tokens, whitespace normalization, and truncation behavior differ per provider, and at two hundred thousand tokens a one percent accounting difference is a two-thousand-token discrepancy on the invoice. Reports should show the locally estimated count and the provider-reported usage side by side.

The failure modes at the long end are quiet. A truncated middle section produces a confident answer about a document the model never effectively saw, and nothing in the response flags the omission. Position-varied probes are the countermeasure: if retrieval accuracy collapses in the middle but holds at the edges, the harness can name the pattern instead of reporting a mean that hides it.

Dataset Import and Row-Level Validation (Part 6)

An evaluation is only as good as its dataset, and most dataset damage happens at import time. A file that parses cleanly can still contain rows with empty references, answers in the wrong type, or duplicate identifiers, and every one of those rows becomes a grading dispute later. Row-level validation at the boundary, with a per-line report, is the cheapest place to catch all of it.

The validation report should be reject-with-reasons, not accept-with-warnings. A row that fails validation must never be silently dropped or silently coerced: the importer returns the line number, the field, and the reason, and the run either proceeds without the rejected rows or does not proceed at all. Silent coercion is worse than silent dropping, because the data appears to be what it is not.

Identifier discipline keeps histories auditable. If rows can share an id, a report that references question twelve is ambiguous, and joining an old run against the current dataset produces nonsense. Enforcing uniqueness at import costs one hash set; retrofitting auditability onto a dataset with duplicate ids costs a migration and an apology.

Field-level types should be declared, not inferred. A reference answer that is sometimes a string and sometimes a number forces every downstream consumer to guess, and the guesses will disagree. The import schema declares the type per field, the validator enforces it per row, and the grader can then trust what it reads.

Versioning closes the loop. Datasets evolve: questions are reworded, references are corrected, rows are added. A run that stores a frozen snapshot of the questions it measured stays reproducible after the live dataset moves on, and the snapshot should record which version of the dataset it was taken from. The alternative is reports that cannot be reproduced by their own author.

评测的上限由数据集决定，而数据集的损伤大多发生在导入时。一个解析无误的文件，仍可能包含参考答案为空的行、类型错误的答案、重复的标识符，每一行都会在日后变成一场判分争议。在边界处做逐行校验并给出带行号的报告，是拦截这一切成本最低的位置。

校验报告应当是"拒绝并说明理由"，而不是"接受并附警告"。校验失败的行绝不能被悄悄丢弃或悄悄修正：导入器返回行号、字段与原因，运行要么在剔除这些行之后继续，要么干脆不继续。静默修正比静默丢弃更糟，因为数据看起来已经不是它本来的样子。

标识符纪律让历史可审计。如果不同的行可以共用一个 id，那么"第 12 题判错了"这句话就是有歧义的，把一次旧运行与当前数据集做关联会得出毫无意义的结论。在导入时强制唯一性只花一个哈希集合；而在 id 重复的数据集上事后补审计，要花一次迁移外加一句道歉。

字段类型应当声明，而不是推断。一个有时是字符串、有时是数字的参考答案，会逼每个下游消费者去猜，而猜测的结果互不一致。导入 schema 为每个字段声明类型，校验器逐行执行，判分器从此可以信任它读到的内容。

版本管理为整个流程收尾。数据集会演化：题目被改写、参考答案被修正、行被添加。一次运行如果存储了它所测题目的冻结快照，在活数据集继续演化之后依然可复现，而且快照应当记录它取自数据集的哪个版本。另一条路的尽头，是连作者自己都无法复现的报告。

Latency Measurement in API Benchmarks (Part 7)

A measurement harness therefore has to separate connection setup, queueing, inference, and stream drain. Each request should record when the TCP connection opened, when the request body was written, when the first byte of the response arrived, and when the stream closed. From these raw timestamps every derived metric, including p50 and p99 figures, can be recomputed later without re-running the workload.

Retries deserve explicit accounting. A provider that silently retries a failed stream behind the same request will report a latency distribution that hides the failure, and a client-side retry policy will double-count the attempt. The harness should mark the retry in the sample rather than folding it into a single blended number, so the report can show both the success-path latency and the cost of recovering from errors.

Warmup iterations exist because the first request to a fresh endpoint pays for TLS negotiation, connection pooling, and occasionally a cold model instance. Discarding the first few samples is standard practice, but the harness should record how many were discarded, because a benchmark that hides its warmup policy is difficult to compare against one that does not.

Finally, wall-clock timing on a busy machine is noisy. The generator process should pin its own scheduling as far as the runtime allows, avoid running other work in parallel, and report the machine load alongside the results. Numbers produced on a laptop while a build is running are not comparable with numbers produced on an idle server, and honest reports say so.

Latency in an LLM API is not a single number. Time to first token and time to last token describe different layers of the serving stack, and a benchmark that collapses them into one mean throws away the information that operators actually need. A gateway that buffers the entire response before forwarding will look identical to a streaming endpoint at the aggregate level, while feeling completely different to a user watching the screen.

API 基准测试中的延迟测量 (Part 7)

因此测量工具必须把连接建立、排队、推理与流式收尾分开记录。每个请求都应记录 TCP 连接打开的时刻、请求体写完的时刻、响应首字节到达的时刻，以及流关闭的时刻。有了这些原始时间戳，包括 p50、p99 在内的所有派生指标都可以事后重新计算，而不必重跑整个负载。

重试需要显式记账。供应商在同一请求背后悄悄重试失败的流，会报告出一个掩盖失败的延迟分布；客户端侧的重试策略则会让一次尝试被统计两次。测量工具应当把重试标记在样本里，而不是混进一个笼统的数字，这样报告才能同时呈现成功路径的延迟与从错误中恢复的代价。

预热迭代的存在，是因为打到新端点的第一个请求要支付 TLS 握手、连接池初始化，偶尔还有冷启动的模型实例。丢弃前几个样本是通行做法，但工具必须记录丢弃了多少个：一个不披露预热策略的基准，是无法与披露了的基准相互比较的。

最后，繁忙机器上的墙钟时间充满噪声。压测进程应尽量固定自身的调度，避免与其他工作并行，并把机器负载与结果一同报告。笔记本在跑构建的同时测出来的数字，与空闲服务器上测出来的数字没有可比性，诚实的报告会把这一点写明白。

大模型 API 的延迟从来不是单一数字。首字延迟与尾字延迟描述的是服务栈的不同层面，把两者折叠成一个平均值的基准测试，丢掉的恰恰是运维人员最需要的信息。一个在转发前缓冲完整响应的网关，在聚合指标上与流式端点看不出差别，但对于盯着屏幕等首字的用户来说，体验完全不同。

Token Accounting and Cost Estimation (Part 7)

Cost estimation before a run is a different problem from cost accounting after it. Before the run, the platform only knows the prompt length and configured output limits, so the estimate is a bound: the guaranteed floor if the model answers tersely, and the ceiling if it rambles to the limit. Presenting a single pre-run number without that interval invites users to treat a guess as a promise.

Tiered pricing makes the arithmetic worse. Many providers charge less for cached input tokens than for fresh ones, which means the same workload can cost half as much on the second run. A cost model that wants to reflect reality needs a separate rate per token class, and the workload configuration needs a way to express the expected cache-hit ratio, because that ratio, not the raw prompt length, often dominates the bill.

Per-model price configuration belongs in versioned storage, not in a config file someone edits by hand. Prices change, and a report that cannot say which price table produced its cost column is not auditable. The report should embed the unit prices alongside the totals, so a reader can recompute the arithmetic with a calculator and confirm it.

Rounding is a small detail with a visible footprint. Summing unrounded per-request costs and rounding only at the end gives a different total than rounding each row first, and finance teams notice. The platform should round once, at presentation time, and keep full precision in the stored samples.

Every billing dispute with a model provider starts with a disagreement about token counts. The number a client computes locally with an offline tokenizer will drift from the number in the usage field of the response, because the server may normalize whitespace, count tool-call envelopes, or use a newer tokenizer revision. A benchmark platform that wants credible cost numbers has to decide which side of that disagreement it reports, and say so in the documentation.

Token 计量与成本预估 (Part 7)

跑前预估与跑后核算是两个不同的问题。跑之前，平台只知道提示词长度和配置的输出上限，所以预估只能是一个区间：模型答得简短时的保底值，与它一路写到上限时的封顶值。给出一个不带区间的单一预估数字，等于把猜测包装成承诺。

阶梯定价让算术更复杂。很多供应商对缓存命中的输入 token 收费更低，同样的负载第二次跑可能只花一半的钱。想反映现实的成本模型需要为每一类 token 单独立价，负载配置也需要能表达预期的缓存命中率——因为主导账单的往往不是提示词长度，而是这个比例。

每模型的价格配置应当放进带版本管理的存储，而不是一个有人手工编辑的配置文件。价格会变，一份说不出自己用的是哪张价格表的报告，谈不上可审计。报告应当把单价与总额一起嵌入，读者拿计算器就能复核这笔账。

舍入是个小细节，却有显眼的痕迹。先累加未舍入的每请求成本、最后统一舍入，与逐行先舍入再累加，会得到不同的总额，财务团队会注意到。平台应当只在展示时舍入一次，存储的样本里保留完整精度。

与模型供应商的每一次账单争议，都始于对 token 数量的分歧。客户端用离线分词器算出的数字，与响应 usage 字段里的数字会有出入：服务端可能做了空白归一化、把工具调用的信封也算进去，或者用了更新版本的分词器。想要让成本数字可信的评测平台，必须决定自己报告分歧的哪一边，并把它写进文档。

Prompt Caching and Prefix Reuse (Part 7)

That invisibility is why benchmark suites treat cache behavior as something to be controlled rather than observed. A workload can pin the hit ratio by design: run the first iteration with a unique suffix to prime the cache, then replay with identical prefixes to harvest the discount. Between providers the accounting differs, some report cached tokens explicitly and some only show a cheaper total, so the harness has to normalize both shapes into one comparable field.

TTL is the quiet variable. A cache entry may expire in seconds or minutes depending on provider and load, and a benchmark that assumes hits will measure nothing at all if the gap between iterations outlasts the entry. Spacing matters as much as content: two identical requests fifty milliseconds apart and two identical requests five minutes apart are experiments on different systems.

The shared-prefix pattern also has a failure mode worth measuring: prompts that share a prefix only up to a diverging middle section. Systems differ in how they handle partial overlap, and a workload built from a common system prompt followed by per-task bodies will expose that boundary. Reporting per-request cache ratios alongside the aggregate tells you where the boundary sits.

Deterministic replay is the final requirement. If the harness shuffles content between runs, the hit ratio becomes an accident of ordering rather than a property of the workload. Fixing the request order and recording it in the report turns cache behavior from an anecdote into a reproducible number.

Prefix caching changes the economics of repeated workloads. When a provider recognizes that an incoming request shares a long prefix with a recent one, it can skip recomputing the attention keys for that prefix and charge a reduced rate for the cached portion. The mechanism is invisible at the protocol level: the request looks the same whether or not the cache fires, and the only evidence is a usage breakdown in the response.

提示词缓存与前缀复用 (Part 7)

正因为不可见，基准套件把缓存行为当作需要控制的对象而不是需要观察的现象。负载可以按设计钉死命中率：第一轮迭代用唯一后缀预热缓存，随后用完全相同的前缀回放来收割折扣。各家供应商的记账方式不同，有的显式报告缓存 token 数，有的只给出更便宜的总价，工具必须把两种形态归一成同一个可比字段。

TTL 是那个安静的变量。缓存条目的存活期可能只有几秒或几分钟，取决于供应商与负载；如果两次迭代之间的间隔超过了条目寿命，假定会命中的基准什么也测不到。间距与内容同样重要：相隔五十毫秒的两个相同请求，与相隔五分钟的两个相同请求，是针对不同系统的实验。

共享前缀模式还有一个值得测量的失败形态：提示词只在中段之前共享前缀，之后分岔。不同系统处理部分重叠的方式不同，用公共系统提示词加逐任务正文构造的负载会把这个边界暴露出来。除了聚合值之外逐请求报告缓存比例，就能看出边界在哪里。

最后一条要求是确定性回放。如果工具在两次运行之间打乱内容顺序，命中率就成了排序的偶然产物，而不是负载的属性。固定请求顺序并把它写进报告，缓存行为才能从轶事变成可复现的数字。

前缀缓存改变了重复性负载的成本结构。当供应商识别出到来的请求与近期某个请求共享很长的前缀时，可以跳过该前缀的注意力键值重算，并对缓存部分按折扣计费。这个机制在协议层完全不可见：缓存是否命中，请求看起来一模一样，唯一的证据是响应里的用量明细。

Concurrency Control and Rate Limiting (Part 7)

A token bucket is the standard shape for the global rate cap. Requests acquire a token before dispatch, refill happens at a fixed rate, and bursts up to the bucket size are allowed. The elegance of the scheme is that it composes: a global bucket caps the aggregate, while per-task concurrency limits bound each phase of a multi-task workflow independently.

Jitter between tasks is the other half of politeness. Sending the next phase the instant the previous one ends produces sawtooth load that no production system exhibits. A randomized interval, recorded in the configuration, turns the sharp edge into a slope and makes the run friendlier to shared endpoints without changing what the per-request metrics mean.

Failure policies interact with concurrency in non-obvious ways. Fail-fast aborts the run at the first error, which preserves budget but discards the distribution. Fail-open keeps going and risks compounding an outage into a bill. Recording which policy was active, alongside a per-phase error count, lets a reader judge whether a suspicious dip in throughput was a real property of the endpoint or one bad minute.

Finally, the harness should verify its own arithmetic. If five thousand requests were configured and the report shows five thousand samples, the count alone does not prove they were all dispatched under the intended ceiling; the dispatch log with per-request acquire timestamps does. Keeping that log, even in compressed form, is what separates a benchmark from an anecdote generator.

A load generator without a throttle is a denial-of-service tool pointed at your own benchmark results. Unbounded concurrency floods the provider, triggers rate-limit responses, and produces a latency distribution dominated by the error handling path. The interesting measurements live below the saturation point, so the harness needs a first-class concurrency setting, and the report needs to state what it was.

并发控制与速率限制 (Part 7)

令牌桶是全局速率上限的标准形态。请求在派发前先取一个令牌，令牌按固定速率补充，桶容量允许一定突发。这个方案的优雅之处在于可组合：一个全局桶封顶总速率，而每个任务的并发上限各自独立地约束多任务工作流的每个阶段。

任务间抖动是礼貌的另一半。上一阶段一结束就立刻发出下一阶段，会产生生产系统里根本不存在的锯齿状负载。一个随机化的间隔、连同它的配置一起被记录下来，能把锯齿的尖角磨成斜坡，让这次运行对共享端点更友好，同时不改变任何单请求指标的含义。

失败策略与并发以不明显的方式相互作用。失败即停会在第一个错误处中止整场运行，保住了预算却丢掉了分布；失败继续则会冒着把一次故障滚成一张账单的风险。把生效的策略与每个阶段的错误计数一起记录，读者才能判断吞吐曲线上可疑的下凹，究竟是端点的真实属性，还是糟糕的一分钟。

最后，工具应当验证自己的算术。配置了五千个请求、报告里也有五千个样本，并不能证明它们都在预期的上限之内派发；能证明这一点的是带逐请求取令牌时间戳的派发日志。把这份日志留着，哪怕是压缩形态，也是基准测试与轶事生成器的分界线。

没有节流的压测器就是把拒绝服务攻击对准自己的基准结果。无上界的并发会洪泛供应商、触发限流响应，产出一个被错误处理路径主导的延迟分布。有意思的测量都活在饱和点以下，所以工具需要把并发设置作为一等公民，并且报告里必须写明这次跑的是多少。

Model Fingerprinting via Tokenizer Probes (Part 7)

Tokenizer probes are the sharpest of these questions. Tokenization is a property of the vocabulary carried in the model weights, not of the serving layer, and different tokenizer families split the same probe text differently. Feeding a fixed set of English, Chinese, code, and emoji strings and asking for logprobs of the resulting segmentation produces a signature that survives cosmetic changes to the API.

Protocol-level probes complement the tokenizer layer. The shape of the error returned for a nonexistent model name, the presence or absence of structured output support, and the behavior of a prefix-cache replay each reveal choices the operator made. No single probe is conclusive, which is why the verdict is a table of evidence rather than a score: a reader can check each row against their own baseline.

The baseline is what makes the comparison honest. Fingerprints are relative by nature: you record the signature of an endpoint you trust, ideally the vendor official API, and every verification measures distance from that record. Without a baseline the whole exercise collapses into guessing from memorized trivia, which ages badly.

A hard-signal rule outranks any weighted average. If the tokenizer segmentation disagrees sharply with the baseline, the verdict is mismatch, whatever the soft similarity score says. Weighted scores are useful for ranking borderline cases, but they must never be allowed to launder a fatal disagreement into a passing grade.

An endpoint that claims to serve a particular model may in fact be routing to something else: a cheaper sibling, an older revision, or an entirely different family. Capability comparisons against the wrong target are worse than no comparison, because they come with a confident label. Fingerprinting addresses this by asking questions whose answers depend on the underlying model in ways that a proxy cannot easily fake.

分词器探针是其中最锋利的一类。分词方式是模型词表本身的属性，不属于服务层，不同的分词器家族会把同一段探针文本切成不同的样子。喂入一组固定的英文、中文、代码与 emoji 字符串，请求返回结果的概率分布，就能得到一个不因 API 表面改装而失效的签名。

协议层探针与分词器层互为补充。请求一个不存在的模型名时错误返回的形态、结构化输出支持的有无、前缀缓存回放的行为，各自暴露运营方的某个选择。没有哪个单独的探针可以一锤定音，所以结论是一张证据表而不是一个分数：读者可以拿自己的基线逐行复核。

基线是让比较保持诚实的关键。指纹天然是相对的：先对一个你信任的端点——最好是厂商官方 API——采集签名，之后所有核验都度量与这份记录的距离。没有基线，整个练习就退化成靠背诵的冷知识来猜，而冷知识过时得很快。

硬性信号永远优先于任何加权平均。只要分词切分与基线出现尖锐分歧，结论就是不匹配，无论软性相似度得分说了什么。加权得分对排序临界情形有用，但绝不能被允许把一次致命的分歧洗成一个合格的成绩。

一个声称自己运行着某个模型的端点，背后路由到的可能是更便宜的兄弟模型、更老的修订版，甚至完全不同的另一个系列。对着错误的对象做能力比较，比不做比较更糟，因为它还带着一张自信的标签。指纹技术的思路，是提出一些答案依赖底层模型、而代理层难以伪造的问题。

Embedded Storage with SQLite (Part 7)

Write-ahead logging is what makes the single-file story compatible with concurrent request handling. With WAL enabled, readers do not block the writer and the writer does not block readers, which matters when a long benchmark run is appending samples while the UI queries history. The configuration belongs in code next to the schema, with a comment explaining why it is there.

Prepared statements are the second pillar. Re-parsing SQL on every request is wasted latency in the hot path, and binding parameters properly is also the boundary that keeps user-supplied strings out of the query grammar. A thin data-access layer that only ever issues prepared statements makes the safe path the easy path.

Migrations are where embedded databases earn skepticism. There is no DBA to review the DDL, so the migration runner has to be part of the application startup: check the schema version, apply pending steps in a transaction, and refuse to start if the on-disk version is newer than the code understands. Downgrades corrupting a data file is the failure mode to design against.

Finally, the file itself is the unit of archive. A completed benchmark campaign can be preserved by copying one file, attached to an incident report or archived with the results it describes. That property, more than any benchmark score, is what makes a tool trustworthy to the people who have to defend its numbers later.

A self-hosted benchmark tool earns its keep by being boring to operate. The single-file embedded database is the architectural expression of that goal: no daemon to start, no credentials to rotate, no network hop in the hot path, and a backup procedure that is a file copy. For a workload of benchmark runs, sample tables, and reports, the scale at which client-server databases become necessary is far away.

预编译语句是第二根支柱。每个请求都重新解析一遍 SQL 是热路径上白扔的延迟，而正确地绑定参数同时也是把用户输入挡在查询语法之外的边界。一层只发预编译语句的薄数据访问层，让安全路径成为顺手路径。

最后，数据库文件本身就是归档单元。一场完成的评测战役，复制一个文件即可保存，可以作为附件随事故报告一起归档，与它所描述的结果绑在一起。这个特性比任何跑分都更能让工具赢得信任——信任来自日后需要为这些数字辩护的人。

自托管的评测工具要赢得用户，靠的是运维起来足够无聊。单文件嵌入式数据库正是这个目标的架构表达：没有需要启动的守护进程，没有需要轮换的凭据，热路径上没有网络跳数，备份流程就是复制一个文件。对于基准运行、样本表和报告这类负载，离需要客户端-服务器数据库的规模还很远。

Server-Sent Events for Live Progress (Part 7)

The event schema matters more than the transport. A progress event should carry the phase it belongs to, the completed and total counts, and enough identity to survive reordering: if two tasks run in sequence and the stream hiccups, a late event for task one must not be mistaken for progress on task two. Monotonic sequence numbers make stale events detectable on arrival.

Reconnection is where naive implementations lose state. Between the drop and the reconnect, events are gone forever, so the client needs a catch-up path: either the event carries the full phase snapshot rather than a delta, or the client re-queries a status endpoint after reconnecting and reconciles. The first is simpler and costs a little bandwidth; the second is cheaper and costs a little code.

Backpressure is the server problem to solve to solve. A slow client must not buffer unbounded history in memory, so the hub keeps a small ring of recent events per stream and drops what no consumer picked up, relying on the catch-up path to restore coherence. Progress data is expendable by design; the authoritative record lives in the database, not in the wire.

Testing an event stream is easier than it looks if the hub is separated from the transport. The unit test drives the hub directly and asserts on the event sequence; the integration test opens a real HTTP connection and asserts on the wire format. Both matter, because a correct sequence with a malformed frame is exactly the kind of bug that survives code review.

A benchmark run that takes an hour should not require a browser tab to stay open for an hour. Server-sent events give the backend a one-way channel to push progress, and the client reconnects automatically when the connection drops. For progress reporting the protocol asymmetry is exactly right: updates flow server to client, and anything the user wants to change goes over ordinary request endpoints.

事件模式比传输方式更重要。一条进度事件应当携带它所属的阶段、已完成与总数，以及足以在乱序中自证的标识：如果两个任务先后运行而流中断了一次，任务一的迟到事件绝不能被误当成任务二的进度。单调递增的序列号让过期事件到达时即可被识别。

重连是天真实现丢状态的地方。从断开到重连之间的事件永远消失了，所以客户端需要一条补齐路径：要么事件携带完整阶段快照而不是增量，要么客户端在重连后重新查询状态端点并做对账。前者更简单、多花一点带宽；后者更省、多写一点代码。

背压是服务端必须解决的问题。慢客户端不能让历史事件在内存里无界堆积，因此事件枢纽为每条流保留一个小的环形缓冲，没人取走的事件就丢弃，靠补齐路径恢复一致性。进度数据在设计上就是可丢弃的；权威记录在数据库里，不在网络线上。

把事件枢纽与传输层分开之后，测试事件流比看上去容易。单元测试直接驱动枢纽、对事件序列做断言；集成测试打开真实的 HTTP 连接、对线上格式做断言。两者都不可省，因为序列正确而帧格式错误，恰恰是那种能活过代码评审的缺陷。

一场要跑一个小时的基准测试，不应该要求浏览器标签页也开满一个小时。服务端推送事件给了后端一条单向通道去推进度，客户端在连接断开时自动重连。对进度上报而言，这个协议的不对称性恰好正确：更新从服务端流向客户端，用户想改的任何东西都走普通的请求端点。

Deterministic Graders for Model Evaluation (Part 7)

The grader contract has to define what happens when grading is impossible. An endpoint that returned an error did not answer the question, but recording that as a wrong answer conflates model quality with availability. The honest output is a third state, unscored, which is excluded from the pass-rate denominator, and a dataset where nothing could be scored reports that fact instead of a zero percent.

Each grader should emit evidence, not just a verdict. The matched pattern, the parsed numbers on both sides, the tolerance that was applied: storing these with the sample means a disputed grade can be audited without re-running anything. A report where every failure links to its evidence is self-defending against the suspicion that the harness is biased.

Choosing a tolerance is a modeling decision, not an implementation accident. For arithmetic word problems the reference answer is exact, so any tolerance is a loophole; for unit conversions or rounding conventions, requiring exact equality manufactures failures. The dataset, not the grader, carries the tolerance, so the same question can be graded under different policies without editing the task.

Determinism is the property that makes all of this valuable. A grader that runs locally produces the same grade on every machine, every day, at no cost, which means quality regressions in the harness itself are detectable by plain unit tests. That property is worth more than a slightly more human-like judgment, and the two are not in conflict: rule-based grading for what rules can judge, and an LLM judge later, only for the residue.

Judging model output with another model is expensive, slow, and biased by the judge own preferences. For a large class of tasks, none of that machinery is necessary: the reference answer has a structure, and checking a structure is a pure function. Exact match, keyword containment, regular expressions, numeric tolerance, JSON schema validation, and set comparison cover most objective evaluation needs at zero marginal cost.

每个判分器都应当输出证据而不只是判决。命中的模式、两侧各自解析出的数值、应用的容差：把这些与样本一起存储，一次有争议的判分就能在没有重跑任何东西的情况下被审计。每条失败都能点开看证据的报告，本身就能反驳"工具有偏"的怀疑。

确定性是让这一切有价值的性质。本地执行的判分器在每台机器、每一天都给出相同的判分，且零成本，这意味着工具自身的质量回归可以用普通单元测试抓住。这个性质比"更接近人类判断"更有价值，而且两者并不冲突：规则能判的用规则，剩下的留给以后的大模型裁判。

用一个模型去评判另一个模型的输出，开销大、速度慢，还带着裁判模型自身的偏好。对一大类任务来说，这套机器完全没有必要：参考答案本身有结构，而校验一个结构是纯函数。完全匹配、关键词包含、正则格式、数值容差、JSON Schema 校验与集合比较，以零边际成本覆盖了绝大多数客观评测需求。

Reproducibility: Temperature and Sampling (Part 7)

Disclosure has to be structural, not a footnote. The report header should carry the inference settings that were frozen at run time: temperature, maximum output tokens, streaming on or off, and the grader set in effect. Freezing matters because a dataset edited after the run must not silently rewrite history; the snapshot taken at run start is the artifact the report describes.

Even at temperature zero, determinism is a gradient rather than a guarantee. Batching, speculative decoding, and provider-side scheduling can make two identical requests diverge, and a benchmark that treats a single run as ground truth will mistake that variance for signal. Reporting the run-to-run drift for a small fixed probe set tells the reader how much of the spread to believe.

Non-streaming is the safer default for quality runs. Streaming adds an implementation variable that has nothing to do with model quality, and some providers route streamed traffic differently. The performance suite wants streaming because users experience streams; the quality suite wants it off because graders want the complete text. Two suites, two defaults, both stated.

The last piece is environment disclosure. Model revision strings change without notice, so the harness should record the identifier the provider returns with each response. A quality report that cannot name the exact revision it measured will be unreadable in a year, and the failure is silent: the report still looks authoritative while describing a model that no longer exists.

A benchmark whose numbers move between runs has to explain the movement before its other claims deserve attention. Sampling temperature is the largest lever: at temperature zero most providers return the argmax token deterministically, while any positive temperature injects deliberate randomness. A quality evaluation that does not pin and disclose its temperature is measuring its own noise as much as the model.

披露必须是结构化的，而不是脚注。报告顶部应当携带运行时冻结的推理设置：温度、最大输出 token、是否流式、生效的判分器集合。冻结之所以重要，是因为跑完之后再改数据集，绝不能悄悄改写历史；运行开始时拍下的快照才是报告所描述的对象。

即便温度为零，确定性也是一个渐变量而非保证。批处理、投机解码与供应商侧调度都能让两个完全相同的请求走向分岔，把单次运行当作真值的基准，会把这种方差误读成信号。对一小组固定探针集报告运行间的漂移，能让读者知道这些数据里有多少可以相信。

对质量评测而言，非流式是更安全的默认。流式引入了一个与模型质量无关的实现变量，而且部分供应商对流式流量的路由并不相同。性能套件想要流式，因为用户体验到的就是流；质量套件想要关掉，因为判分器要完整文本。两套套件、两个默认值，都要写明。

最后一环是环境披露。模型修订号会在没有任何通知的情况下变化，所以工具应当记录供应商随每次响应返回的标识符。一份说不出自己测的是哪个具体修订版的质量报告，一年后就没人读得懂，而且这种失败是安静的：报告看上去依然权威，描述的却是一个已经不存在的模型。

一个数字每次运行都会漂移的基准测试，必须先解释漂移，其他结论才值得被认真对待。采样温度是最大的那根杠杆：温度为零时，多数供应商确定性地返回概率最大的词元；任何正温度都会注入有意的随机性。一次不钉住、不披露温度的质量评测，测到的与其说是模型，不如说是它自己的噪声。

Failure Semantics and Error Taxonomy (Part 7)

Error taxonomy is what turns raw failures into information. Rate-limit responses, authentication rejections, malformed streams, context-length overflows, and server crashes are different events with different remedies, and a benchmark that buckets them all as unknown error forces the reader to guess. Classification should happen at the adapter layer, where the provider-specific shapes are known, and travel with the sample as a structured field.

The distinction between a failed request and an ungradeable answer is the second structural decision. A request that never completed produced no output to judge; a request that completed with nonsense produced output the grader rejected. Collapsing the two makes availability problems look like quality problems, and a pass-rate computed over that collapsed set answers a question nobody asked.

Aggregation policy follows from the taxonomy. Latency percentiles computed over successful requests only, error rate reported separately, and unscored items excluded from quality denominators: each population must be named in the report. Silent population switching, where the denominator shrinks without explanation, is the most common way honest measurements become dishonest reports.

Finally, stop conditions should be loud. A run that halted after the first failure must say so at the top of the report, because a truncated distribution presented without the truncation notice is indistinguishable from a complete one. The cheapest defense is a status line that states samples planned, samples completed, and the reason the run ended.

The credibility of a measurement tool is decided by what it does when things go wrong. A harness that fills failed requests with plausible-looking synthetic numbers produces beautiful reports that are quietly worthless; a harness that reports the failure honestly produces uglier reports that can be trusted. The design rule is absolute: a number in the report must trace back to a real request, or it must not exist.

错误分类是把原始失败变成信息的手段。限流响应、鉴权拒绝、流格式损坏、上下文长度溢出、服务端崩溃，是不同的事件、有不同的对策；把它们统统归进"未知错误"的基准，等于逼读者去猜。分类应当在适配器层完成——那里最清楚各供应商的错误形态——并作为结构化字段随样本一起传递。

"请求失败"与"答案无法判分"的区分，是第二个结构性决定。一个从未完成的请求没有产出可供评判；一个完成了但输出胡言乱语的请求，产出了被判分器拒绝的答案。把两者混为一谈，会让可用性问题看起来像质量问题，而在混合集合上算出的通过率，回答的是一个没有人问过的问题。

聚合策略从分类中自然推出。延迟分位数只对成功请求计算、错误率单独报告、未能判定的条目排除在质量分母之外：每一处统计口径都必须在报告里点明。口径的静默切换——分母在没有解释的情况下变小——是诚实的测量变成不诚实的报告最常见的路径。

最后，停止条件应当大声宣告。一场在首个失败后就中止的运行，必须在报告顶部说明这一点，因为一个被截断的分布，如果不带截断说明，与完整的分布没有区别。最便宜的防线是一行状态：计划样本数、完成样本数、运行结束的原因。

测量工具的可信度，是由它出错时的行为决定的。一个用看起来合理的合成数字填补失败请求的工具，会产出漂亮却悄悄一文不值的报告；一个如实报告失败的工具，产出的报告更难看，却可以信任。设计规则是绝对的：报告里的每个数字要么能追溯到一个真实请求，要么就不该存在。

Long-Context Behavior and Attention (Part 7)

Multi-document prompts are the practical carrier for these probes. A prompt built from independent documents with a per-document task at the end lets the harness score each document separately: which positions were retrieved, which were skipped, and whether the boundary between documents confused the segmentation. The same prompt shape doubles as a realistic load for latency and cost measurement, since production prompts rarely consist of one homogeneous blob.

Output scope control belongs in the harness, not the prompt author hands. Asking a model to summarize two hundred thousand tokens into three bullets produces a cheap response; asking it to list every document produces a long one. Letting the same prompt template carry an adjustable scope instruction separates the cost of input processing from the cost of output generation, which is exactly the split a capacity planner needs.

Token counting for long inputs is where local estimation diverges most from provider accounting. Special tokens, whitespace normalization, and truncation behavior differ per provider, and at two hundred thousand tokens a one percent accounting difference is a two-thousand-token discrepancy on the invoice. Reports should show the locally estimated count and the provider-reported usage side by side.

The failure modes at the long end are quiet. A truncated middle section produces a confident answer about a document the model never effectively saw, and nothing in the response flags the omission. Position-varied probes are the countermeasure: if retrieval accuracy collapses in the middle but holds at the edges, the harness can name the pattern instead of reporting a mean that hides it.

Context windows are advertised as hard numbers, but quality degrades gradually inside the window rather than failing at its edge. Retrieval accuracy for a fact buried in the middle of a long prompt is typically worse than for the same fact at the beginning or end, a pattern strong enough to have a name. Benchmarking long-context behavior therefore requires probes that vary position deliberately, not just length.

输出范围控制应当属于工具，而不是提示词作者的手工作业。要求模型把二十万 token 总结成三个要点，产出的是廉价响应；要求它列出每个文档，产出的是长响应。让同一个提示词模板携带可调节的范围指令，就把输入处理的成本与输出生成的成本拆开了——这恰恰是容量规划需要的那个拆分。

长输入的 token 计数是本地估算与供应商记账分歧最大的地方。特殊词元、空白归一化与截断行为因供应商而异；二十万 token 的量级下，百分之一的记账差异就是账单上两千 token 的出入。报告应当把本地估算数与供应商上报的用量并排展示。

长文本尽头的失败模式是安静的。中段被截断后，模型会对一个它实际上从未有效看到过的文档给出自信的回答，而响应中没有任何标记提示这个遗漏。位置可变的探针是对策：如果中段的检索准确率塌陷而两端完好，工具就能点名这个模式，而不是报告一个把它藏起来的平均值。

上下文窗口在宣传里是一个硬数字，但质量是在窗口内部逐渐退化，而不是在边界处突然失效。埋在长提示词中段的事实的检索准确率，通常低于同一个事实放在开头或结尾时的准确率，这个模式稳定到拥有自己的名字。因此对长上下文行为的基准测试，需要的是刻意变化位置的探针，而不只是变化长度。

Dataset Import and Row-Level Validation (Part 7)

The validation report should be reject-with-reasons, not accept-with-warnings. A row that fails validation must never be silently dropped or silently coerced: the importer returns the line number, the field, and the reason, and the run either proceeds without the rejected rows or does not proceed at all. Silent coercion is worse than silent dropping, because the data appears to be what it is not.

Identifier discipline keeps histories auditable. If rows can share an id, a report that references question twelve is ambiguous, and joining an old run against the current dataset produces nonsense. Enforcing uniqueness at import costs one hash set; retrofitting auditability onto a dataset with duplicate ids costs a migration and an apology.

Field-level types should be declared, not inferred. A reference answer that is sometimes a string and sometimes a number forces every downstream consumer to guess, and the guesses will disagree. The import schema declares the type per field, the validator enforces it per row, and the grader can then trust what it reads.

Versioning closes the loop. Datasets evolve: questions are reworded, references are corrected, rows are added. A run that stores a frozen snapshot of the questions it measured stays reproducible after the live dataset moves on, and the snapshot should record which version of the dataset it was taken from. The alternative is reports that cannot be reproduced by their own author.

An evaluation is only as good as its dataset, and most dataset damage happens at import time. A file that parses cleanly can still contain rows with empty references, answers in the wrong type, or duplicate identifiers, and every one of those rows becomes a grading dispute later. Row-level validation at the boundary, with a per-line report, is the cheapest place to catch all of it.

字段类型应当声明，而不是推断。一个有时是字符串、有时是数字的参考答案，会逼每个下游消费者去猜，而猜测的结果互不一致。导入 schema 为每个字段声明类型，校验器逐行执行，判分器从此可以信任它读到的内容。

版本管理为整个流程收尾。数据集会演化：题目被改写、参考答案被修正、行被添加。一次运行如果存储了它所测题目的冻结快照，在活数据集继续演化之后依然可复现，而且快照应当记录它取自数据集的哪个版本。另一条路的尽头，是连作者自己都无法复现的报告。

评测的上限由数据集决定，而数据集的损伤大多发生在导入时。一个解析无误的文件，仍可能包含参考答案为空的行、类型错误的答案、重复的标识符，每一行都会在日后变成一场判分争议。在边界处做逐行校验并给出带行号的报告，是拦截这一切成本最低的位置。

Latency Measurement in API Benchmarks (Part 8)

Retries deserve explicit accounting. A provider that silently retries a failed stream behind the same request will report a latency distribution that hides the failure, and a client-side retry policy will double-count the attempt. The harness should mark the retry in the sample rather than folding it into a single blended number, so the report can show both the success-path latency and the cost of recovering from errors.

Warmup iterations exist because the first request to a fresh endpoint pays for TLS negotiation, connection pooling, and occasionally a cold model instance. Discarding the first few samples is standard practice, but the harness should record how many were discarded, because a benchmark that hides its warmup policy is difficult to compare against one that does not.

Finally, wall-clock timing on a busy machine is noisy. The generator process should pin its own scheduling as far as the runtime allows, avoid running other work in parallel, and report the machine load alongside the results. Numbers produced on a laptop while a build is running are not comparable with numbers produced on an idle server, and honest reports say so.

Latency in an LLM API is not a single number. Time to first token and time to last token describe different layers of the serving stack, and a benchmark that collapses them into one mean throws away the information that operators actually need. A gateway that buffers the entire response before forwarding will look identical to a streaming endpoint at the aggregate level, while feeling completely different to a user watching the screen.

A measurement harness therefore has to separate connection setup, queueing, inference, and stream drain. Each request should record when the TCP connection opened, when the request body was written, when the first byte of the response arrived, and when the stream closed. From these raw timestamps every derived metric, including p50 and p99 figures, can be recomputed later without re-running the workload.

重试需要显式记账。供应商在同一请求背后悄悄重试失败的流，会报告出一个掩盖失败的延迟分布；客户端侧的重试策略则会让一次尝试被统计两次。测量工具应当把重试标记在样本里，而不是混进一个笼统的数字，这样报告才能同时呈现成功路径的延迟与从错误中恢复的代价。

预热迭代的存在，是因为打到新端点的第一个请求要支付 TLS 握手、连接池初始化，偶尔还有冷启动的模型实例。丢弃前几个样本是通行做法，但工具必须记录丢弃了多少个：一个不披露预热策略的基准，是无法与披露了的基准相互比较的。

最后，繁忙机器上的墙钟时间充满噪声。压测进程应尽量固定自身的调度，避免与其他工作并行，并把机器负载与结果一同报告。笔记本在跑构建的同时测出来的数字，与空闲服务器上测出来的数字没有可比性，诚实的报告会把这一点写明白。

大模型 API 的延迟从来不是单一数字。首字延迟与尾字延迟描述的是服务栈的不同层面，把两者折叠成一个平均值的基准测试，丢掉的恰恰是运维人员最需要的信息。一个在转发前缓冲完整响应的网关，在聚合指标上与流式端点看不出差别，但对于盯着屏幕等首字的用户来说，体验完全不同。

因此测量工具必须把连接建立、排队、推理与流式收尾分开记录。每个请求都应记录 TCP 连接打开的时刻、请求体写完的时刻、响应首字节到达的时刻，以及流关闭的时刻。有了这些原始时间戳，包括 p50、p99 在内的所有派生指标都可以事后重新计算，而不必重跑整个负载。

[Document 171]
Token Accounting and Cost Estimation (Part 8)

Tiered pricing makes the arithmetic worse. Many providers charge less for cached input tokens than for fresh ones, which means the same workload can cost half as much on the second run. A cost model that wants to reflect reality needs a separate rate per token class, and the workload configuration needs a way to express the expected cache-hit ratio, because that ratio, not the raw prompt length, often dominates the bill.

Per-model price configuration belongs in versioned storage, not in a config file someone edits by hand. Prices change, and a report that cannot say which price table produced its cost column is not auditable. The report should embed the unit prices alongside the totals, so a reader can recompute the arithmetic with a calculator and confirm it.

Rounding is a small detail with a visible footprint. Summing unrounded per-request costs and rounding only at the end gives a different total than rounding each row first, and finance teams notice. The platform should round once, at presentation time, and keep full precision in the stored samples.

Every billing dispute with a model provider starts with a disagreement about token counts. The number a client computes locally with an offline tokenizer will drift from the number in the usage field of the response, because the server may normalize whitespace, count tool-call envelopes, or use a newer tokenizer revision. A benchmark platform that wants credible cost numbers has to decide which side of that disagreement it reports, and say so in the documentation.

Cost estimation before a run is a different problem from cost accounting after it. Before the run, the platform only knows the prompt length and configured output limits, so the estimate is a bound: the guaranteed floor if the model answers tersely, and the ceiling if it rambles to the limit. Presenting a single pre-run number without that interval invites users to treat a guess as a promise.

[Document 172]
Token 计量与成本预估 (Part 8)

阶梯定价让算术更复杂。很多供应商对缓存命中的输入 token 收费更低，同样的负载第二次跑可能只花一半的钱。想反映现实的成本模型需要为每一类 token 单独立价，负载配置也需要能表达预期的缓存命中率——因为主导账单的往往不是提示词长度，而是这个比例。

每模型的价格配置应当放进带版本管理的存储，而不是一个有人手工编辑的配置文件。价格会变，一份说不出自己用的是哪张价格表的报告，谈不上可审计。报告应当把单价与总额一起嵌入，读者拿计算器就能复核这笔账。

舍入是个小细节，却有显眼的痕迹。先累加未舍入的每请求成本、最后统一舍入，与逐行先舍入再累加，会得到不同的总额，财务团队会注意到。平台应当只在展示时舍入一次，存储的样本里保留完整精度。

与模型供应商的每一次账单争议，都始于对 token 数量的分歧。客户端用离线分词器算出的数字，与响应 usage 字段里的数字会有出入：服务端可能做了空白归一化、把工具调用的信封也算进去，或者用了更新版本的分词器。想要让成本数字可信的评测平台，必须决定自己报告分歧的哪一边，并把它写进文档。

跑前预估与跑后核算是两个不同的问题。跑之前，平台只知道提示词长度和配置的输出上限，所以预估只能是一个区间：模型答得简短时的保底值，与它一路写到上限时的封顶值。给出一个不带区间的单一预估数字，等于把猜测包装成承诺。

[Document 173]
Prompt Caching and Prefix Reuse (Part 8)

TTL is the quiet variable. A cache entry may expire in seconds or minutes depending on provider and load, and a benchmark that assumes hits will measure nothing at all if the gap between iterations outlasts the entry. Spacing matters as much as content: two identical requests fifty milliseconds apart and two identical requests five minutes apart are experiments on different systems.

The shared-prefix pattern also has a failure mode worth measuring: prompts that share a prefix only up to a diverging middle section. Systems differ in how they handle partial overlap, and a workload built from a common system prompt followed by per-task bodies will expose that boundary. Reporting per-request cache ratios alongside the aggregate tells you where the boundary sits.

Deterministic replay is the final requirement. If the harness shuffles content between runs, the hit ratio becomes an accident of ordering rather than a property of the workload. Fixing the request order and recording it in the report turns cache behavior from an anecdote into a reproducible number.

Prefix caching changes the economics of repeated workloads. When a provider recognizes that an incoming request shares a long prefix with a recent one, it can skip recomputing the attention keys for that prefix and charge a reduced rate for the cached portion. The mechanism is invisible at the protocol level: the request looks the same whether or not the cache fires, and the only evidence is a usage breakdown in the response.

That invisibility is why benchmark suites treat cache behavior as something to be controlled rather than observed. A workload can pin the hit ratio by design: run the first iteration with a unique suffix to prime the cache, then replay with identical prefixes to harvest the discount. Between providers the accounting differs, some report cached tokens explicitly and some only show a cheaper total, so the harness has to normalize both shapes into one comparable field.

[Document 174]
提示词缓存与前缀复用 (Part 8)

TTL 是那个安静的变量。缓存条目的存活期可能只有几秒或几分钟，取决于供应商与负载；如果两次迭代之间的间隔超过了条目寿命，假定会命中的基准什么也测不到。间距与内容同样重要：相隔五十毫秒的两个相同请求，与相隔五分钟的两个相同请求，是针对不同系统的实验。

共享前缀模式还有一个值得测量的失败形态：提示词只在中段之前共享前缀，之后分岔。不同系统处理部分重叠的方式不同，用公共系统提示词加逐任务正文构造的负载会把这个边界暴露出来。除了聚合值之外逐请求报告缓存比例，就能看出边界在哪里。

最后一条要求是确定性回放。如果工具在两次运行之间打乱内容顺序，命中率就成了排序的偶然产物，而不是负载的属性。固定请求顺序并把它写进报告，缓存行为才能从轶事变成可复现的数字。

前缀缓存改变了重复性负载的成本结构。当供应商识别出到来的请求与近期某个请求共享很长的前缀时，可以跳过该前缀的注意力键值重算，并对缓存部分按折扣计费。这个机制在协议层完全不可见：缓存是否命中，请求看起来一模一样，唯一的证据是响应里的用量明细。

正因为不可见，基准套件把缓存行为当作需要控制的对象而不是需要观察的现象。负载可以按设计钉死命中率：第一轮迭代用唯一后缀预热缓存，随后用完全相同的前缀回放来收割折扣。各家供应商的记账方式不同，有的显式报告缓存 token 数，有的只给出更便宜的总价，工具必须把两种形态归一成同一个可比字段。

[Document 175]
Concurrency Control and Rate Limiting (Part 8)

Jitter between tasks is the other half of politeness. Sending the next phase the instant the previous one ends produces sawtooth load that no production system exhibits. A randomized interval, recorded in the configuration, turns the sharp edge into a slope and makes the run friendlier to shared endpoints without changing what the per-request metrics mean.

Failure policies interact with concurrency in non-obvious ways. Fail-fast aborts the run at the first error, which preserves budget but discards the distribution. Fail-open keeps going and risks compounding an outage into a bill. Recording which policy was active, alongside a per-phase error count, lets a reader judge whether a suspicious dip in throughput was a real property of the endpoint or one bad minute.

Finally, the harness should verify its own arithmetic. If five thousand requests were configured and the report shows five thousand samples, the count alone does not prove they were all dispatched under the intended ceiling; the dispatch log with per-request acquire timestamps does. Keeping that log, even in compressed form, is what separates a benchmark from an anecdote generator.

A load generator without a throttle is a denial-of-service tool pointed at your own benchmark results. Unbounded concurrency floods the provider, triggers rate-limit responses, and produces a latency distribution dominated by the error handling path. The interesting measurements live below the saturation point, so the harness needs a first-class concurrency setting, and the report needs to state what it was.

A token bucket is the standard shape for the global rate cap. Requests acquire a token before dispatch, refill happens at a fixed rate, and bursts up to the bucket size are allowed. The elegance of the scheme is that it composes: a global bucket caps the aggregate, while per-task concurrency limits bound each phase of a multi-task workflow independently.

[Document 176]
并发控制与速率限制 (Part 8)

任务间抖动是礼貌的另一半。上一阶段一结束就立刻发出下一阶段，会产生生产系统里根本不存在的锯齿状负载。一个随机化的间隔、连同它的配置一起被记录下来，能把锯齿的尖角磨成斜坡，让这次运行对共享端点更友好，同时不改变任何单请求指标的含义。

失败策略与并发以不明显的方式相互作用。失败即停会在第一个错误处中止整场运行，保住了预算却丢掉了分布；失败继续则会冒着把一次故障滚成一张账单的风险。把生效的策略与每个阶段的错误计数一起记录，读者才能判断吞吐曲线上可疑的下凹，究竟是端点的真实属性，还是糟糕的一分钟。

最后，工具应当验证自己的算术。配置了五千个请求、报告里也有五千个样本，并不能证明它们都在预期的上限之内派发；能证明这一点的是带逐请求取令牌时间戳的派发日志。把这份日志留着，哪怕是压缩形态，也是基准测试与轶事生成器的分界线。

没有节流的压测器就是把拒绝服务攻击对准自己的基准结果。无上界的并发会洪泛供应商、触发限流响应，产出一个被错误处理路径主导的延迟分布。有意思的测量都活在饱和点以下，所以工具需要把并发设置作为一等公民，并且报告里必须写明这次跑的是多少。

令牌桶是全局速率上限的标准形态。请求在派发前先取一个令牌，令牌按固定速率补充，桶容量允许一定突发。这个方案的优雅之处在于可组合：一个全局桶封顶总速率，而每个任务的并发上限各自独立地约束多任务工作流的每个阶段。

[Document 177]
Model Fingerprinting via Tokenizer Probes (Part 8)

Protocol-level probes complement the tokenizer layer. The shape of the error returned for a nonexistent model name, the presence or absence of structured output support, and the behavior of a prefix-cache replay each reveal choices the operator made. No single probe is conclusive, which is why the verdict is a table of evidence rather than a score: a reader can check each row against their own baseline.

The baseline is what makes the comparison honest. Fingerprints are relative by nature: you record the signature of an endpoint you trust, ideally the vendor official API, and every verification measures distance from that record. Without a baseline the whole exercise collapses into guessing from memorized trivia, which ages badly.

A hard-signal rule outranks any weighted average. If the tokenizer segmentation disagrees sharply with the baseline, the verdict is mismatch, whatever the soft similarity score says. Weighted scores are useful for ranking borderline cases, but they must never be allowed to launder a fatal disagreement into a passing grade.

An endpoint that claims to serve a particular model may in fact be routing to something else: a cheaper sibling, an older revision, or an entirely different family. Capability comparisons against the wrong target are worse than no comparison, because they come with a confident label. Fingerprinting addresses this by asking questions whose answers depend on the underlying model in ways that a proxy cannot easily fake.

Tokenizer probes are the sharpest of these questions. Tokenization is a property of the vocabulary carried in the model weights, not of the serving layer, and different tokenizer families split the same probe text differently. Feeding a fixed set of English, Chinese, code, and emoji strings and asking for logprobs of the resulting segmentation produces a signature that survives cosmetic changes to the API.

[Document 178]
基于分词器探针的模型指纹 (Part 8)

协议层探针与分词器层互为补充。请求一个不存在的模型名时错误返回的形态、结构化输出支持的有无、前缀缓存回放的行为，各自暴露运营方的某个选择。没有哪个单独的探针可以一锤定音，所以结论是一张证据表而不是一个分数：读者可以拿自己的基线逐行复核。

基线是让比较保持诚实的关键。指纹天然是相对的：先对一个你信任的端点——最好是厂商官方 API——采集签名，之后所有核验都度量与这份记录的距离。没有基线，整个练习就退化成靠背诵的冷知识来猜，而冷知识过时得很快。

硬性信号永远优先于任何加权平均。只要分词切分与基线出现尖锐分歧，结论就是不匹配，无论软性相似度得分说了什么。加权得分对排序临界情形有用，但绝不能被允许把一次致命的分歧洗成一个合格的成绩。

一个声称自己运行着某个模型的端点，背后路由到的可能是更便宜的兄弟模型、更老的修订版，甚至完全不同的另一个系列。对着错误的对象做能力比较，比不做比较更糟，因为它还带着一张自信的标签。指纹技术的思路，是提出一些答案依赖底层模型、而代理层难以伪造的问题。

分词器探针是其中最锋利的一类。分词方式是模型词表本身的属性，不属于服务层，不同的分词器家族会把同一段探针文本切成不同的样子。喂入一组固定的英文、中文、代码与 emoji 字符串，请求返回结果的概率分布，就能得到一个不因 API 表面改装而失效的签名。

[Document 179]
Embedded Storage with SQLite (Part 8)

Prepared statements are the second pillar. Re-parsing SQL on every request is wasted latency in the hot path, and binding parameters properly is also the boundary that keeps user-supplied strings out of the query grammar. A thin data-access layer that only ever issues prepared statements makes the safe path the easy path.

Migrations are where embedded databases earn skepticism. There is no DBA to review the DDL, so the migration runner has to be part of the application startup: check the schema version, apply pending steps in a transaction, and refuse to start if the on-disk version is newer than the code understands. Downgrades corrupting a data file is the failure mode to design against.

Finally, the file itself is the unit of archive. A completed benchmark campaign can be preserved by copying one file, attached to an incident report or archived with the results it describes. That property, more than any benchmark score, is what makes a tool trustworthy to the people who have to defend its numbers later.

A self-hosted benchmark tool earns its keep by being boring to operate. The single-file embedded database is the architectural expression of that goal: no daemon to start, no credentials to rotate, no network hop in the hot path, and a backup procedure that is a file copy. For a workload of benchmark runs, sample tables, and reports, the scale at which client-server databases become necessary is far away.

Write-ahead logging is what makes the single-file story compatible with concurrent request handling. With WAL enabled, readers do not block the writer and the writer does not block readers, which matters when a long benchmark run is appending samples while the UI queries history. The configuration belongs in code next to the schema, with a comment explaining why it is there.

[Document 180]
基于 SQLite 的嵌入式存储 (Part 8)

预编译语句是第二根支柱。每个请求都重新解析一遍 SQL 是热路径上白扔的延迟，而正确地绑定参数同时也是把用户输入挡在查询语法之外的边界。一层只发预编译语句的薄数据访问层，让安全路径成为顺手路径。

迁移是嵌入式数据库最容易被质疑的地方。没有 DBA 帮你审 DDL，所以迁移执行器必须是应用启动流程的一部分：检查 schema 版本，在事务里按序应用未执行的步骤，磁盘版本比代码认知更新时拒绝启动。要预防的失败模式就是降级把数据文件弄坏。

最后，数据库文件本身就是归档单元。一场完成的评测战役，复制一个文件即可保存，可以作为附件随事故报告一起归档，与它所描述的结果绑在一起。这个特性比任何跑分都更能让工具赢得信任——信任来自日后需要为这些数字辩护的人。

自托管的评测工具要赢得用户，靠的是运维起来足够无聊。单文件嵌入式数据库正是这个目标的架构表达：没有需要启动的守护进程，没有需要轮换的凭据，热路径上没有网络跳数，备份流程就是复制一个文件。对于基准运行、样本表和报告这类负载，离需要客户端-服务器数据库的规模还很远。

预写日志是单文件方案与并发请求处理兼容的关键。开启 WAL 之后，读不阻塞写、写不阻塞读——当一场长时间的基准运行在追加样本、而界面同时在查询历史时，这一点至关重要。这份配置应当与建表语句放在一起写进代码，并附一句注释说明它为什么在那里。

[Document 181]
Server-Sent Events for Live Progress (Part 8)

Reconnection is where naive implementations lose state. Between the drop and the reconnect, events are gone forever, so the client needs a catch-up path: either the event carries the full phase snapshot rather than a delta, or the client re-queries a status endpoint after reconnecting and reconciles. The first is simpler and costs a little bandwidth; the second is cheaper and costs a little code.

Backpressure is the server problem to solve to solve. A slow client must not buffer unbounded history in memory, so the hub keeps a small ring of recent events per stream and drops what no consumer picked up, relying on the catch-up path to restore coherence. Progress data is expendable by design; the authoritative record lives in the database, not in the wire.

Testing an event stream is easier than it looks if the hub is separated from the transport. The unit test drives the hub directly and asserts on the event sequence; the integration test opens a real HTTP connection and asserts on the wire format. Both matter, because a correct sequence with a malformed frame is exactly the kind of bug that survives code review.

A benchmark run that takes an hour should not require a browser tab to stay open for an hour. Server-sent events give the backend a one-way channel to push progress, and the client reconnects automatically when the connection drops. For progress reporting the protocol asymmetry is exactly right: updates flow server to client, and anything the user wants to change goes over ordinary request endpoints.

The event schema matters more than the transport. A progress event should carry the phase it belongs to, the completed and total counts, and enough identity to survive reordering: if two tasks run in sequence and the stream hiccups, a late event for task one must not be mistaken for progress on task two. Monotonic sequence numbers make stale events detectable on arrival.

[Document 182]
用 SSE 推送实时进度 (Part 8)

重连是天真实现丢状态的地方。从断开到重连之间的事件永远消失了，所以客户端需要一条补齐路径：要么事件携带完整阶段快照而不是增量，要么客户端在重连后重新查询状态端点并做对账。前者更简单、多花一点带宽；后者更省、多写一点代码。

背压是服务端必须解决的问题。慢客户端不能让历史事件在内存里无界堆积，因此事件枢纽为每条流保留一个小的环形缓冲，没人取走的事件就丢弃，靠补齐路径恢复一致性。进度数据在设计上就是可丢弃的；权威记录在数据库里，不在网络线上。

把事件枢纽与传输层分开之后，测试事件流比看上去容易。单元测试直接驱动枢纽、对事件序列做断言；集成测试打开真实的 HTTP 连接、对线上格式做断言。两者都不可省，因为序列正确而帧格式错误，恰恰是那种能活过代码评审的缺陷。

一场要跑一个小时的基准测试，不应该要求浏览器标签页也开满一个小时。服务端推送事件给了后端一条单向通道去推进度，客户端在连接断开时自动重连。对进度上报而言，这个协议的不对称性恰好正确：更新从服务端流向客户端，用户想改的任何东西都走普通的请求端点。

事件模式比传输方式更重要。一条进度事件应当携带它所属的阶段、已完成与总数，以及足以在乱序中自证的标识：如果两个任务先后运行而流中断了一次，任务一的迟到事件绝不能被误当成任务二的进度。单调递增的序列号让过期事件到达时即可被识别。

[Document 183]
Deterministic Graders for Model Evaluation (Part 8)

Each grader should emit evidence, not just a verdict. The matched pattern, the parsed numbers on both sides, the tolerance that was applied: storing these with the sample means a disputed grade can be audited without re-running anything. A report where every failure links to its evidence is self-defending against the suspicion that the harness is biased.

Choosing a tolerance is a modeling decision, not an implementation accident. For arithmetic word problems the reference answer is exact, so any tolerance is a loophole; for unit conversions or rounding conventions, requiring exact equality manufactures failures. The dataset, not the grader, carries the tolerance, so the same question can be graded under different policies without editing the task.

Determinism is the property that makes all of this valuable. A grader that runs locally produces the same grade on every machine, every day, at no cost, which means quality regressions in the harness itself are detectable by plain unit tests. That property is worth more than a slightly more human-like judgment, and the two are not in conflict: rule-based grading for what rules can judge, and an LLM judge later, only for the residue.

Judging model output with another model is expensive, slow, and biased by the judge own preferences. For a large class of tasks, none of that machinery is necessary: the reference answer has a structure, and checking a structure is a pure function. Exact match, keyword containment, regular expressions, numeric tolerance, JSON schema validation, and set comparison cover most objective evaluation needs at zero marginal cost.

The grader contract has to define what happens when grading is impossible. An endpoint that returned an error did not answer the question, but recording that as a wrong answer conflates model quality with availability. The honest output is a third state, unscored, which is excluded from the pass-rate denominator, and a dataset where nothing could be scored reports that fact instead of a zero percent.

确定性判分器设计 (Part 8)

每个判分器都应当输出证据而不只是判决。命中的模式、两侧各自解析出的数值、应用的容差：把这些与样本一起存储，一次有争议的判分就能在没有重跑任何东西的情况下被审计。每条失败都能点开看证据的报告，本身就能反驳"工具有偏"的怀疑。

选择容差是建模决策，不是实现时的顺手为之。算术应用题的参考答案是精确的，任何容差都是漏洞；而单位换算或四舍五入惯例类的问题，要求完全相等就是在制造失败。容差应当跟着数据集走而不是跟着判分器走，同一道题就能在不同策略下判分而无需改题。

确定性是让这一切有价值的性质。本地执行的判分器在每台机器、每一天都给出相同的判分，且零成本，这意味着工具自身的质量回归可以用普通单元测试抓住。这个性质比"更接近人类判断"更有价值，而且两者并不冲突：规则能判的用规则，剩下的留给以后的大模型裁判。

用一个模型去评判另一个模型的输出，开销大、速度慢，还带着裁判模型自身的偏好。对一大类任务来说，这套机器完全没有必要：参考答案本身有结构，而校验一个结构是纯函数。完全匹配、关键词包含、正则格式、数值容差、JSON Schema 校验与集合比较，以零边际成本覆盖了绝大多数客观评测需求。

判分器契约必须定义"无法判分"时发生什么。返回了错误的端点并没有回答问题，但把它记成答错，就把模型质量与可用性混为一谈。诚实的输出是第三种状态——未能判定，它被排除在通过率的分母之外；而当一道题都没能判分时，数据集应当如实报告这一点，而不是显示一个百分之零。

Reproducibility: Temperature and Sampling (Part 8)

Even at temperature zero, determinism is a gradient rather than a guarantee. Batching, speculative decoding, and provider-side scheduling can make two identical requests diverge, and a benchmark that treats a single run as ground truth will mistake that variance for signal. Reporting the run-to-run drift for a small fixed probe set tells the reader how much of the spread to believe.

Non-streaming is the safer default for quality runs. Streaming adds an implementation variable that has nothing to do with model quality, and some providers route streamed traffic differently. The performance suite wants streaming because users experience streams; the quality suite wants it off because graders want the complete text. Two suites, two defaults, both stated.

The last piece is environment disclosure. Model revision strings change without notice, so the harness should record the identifier the provider returns with each response. A quality report that cannot name the exact revision it measured will be unreadable in a year, and the failure is silent: the report still looks authoritative while describing a model that no longer exists.

A benchmark whose numbers move between runs has to explain the movement before its other claims deserve attention. Sampling temperature is the largest lever: at temperature zero most providers return the argmax token deterministically, while any positive temperature injects deliberate randomness. A quality evaluation that does not pin and disclose its temperature is measuring its own noise as much as the model.

Disclosure has to be structural, not a footnote. The report header should carry the inference settings that were frozen at run time: temperature, maximum output tokens, streaming on or off, and the grader set in effect. Freezing matters because a dataset edited after the run must not silently rewrite history; the snapshot taken at run start is the artifact the report describes.

可复现性：温度与采样 (Part 8)

即便温度为零，确定性也是一个渐变量而非保证。批处理、投机解码与供应商侧调度都能让两个完全相同的请求走向分岔，把单次运行当作真值的基准，会把这种方差误读成信号。对一小组固定探针集报告运行间的漂移，能让读者知道这些数据里有多少可以相信。

对质量评测而言，非流式是更安全的默认。流式引入了一个与模型质量无关的实现变量，而且部分供应商对流式流量的路由并不相同。性能套件想要流式，因为用户体验到的就是流；质量套件想要关掉，因为判分器要完整文本。两套套件、两个默认值，都要写明。

最后一环是环境披露。模型修订号会在没有任何通知的情况下变化，所以工具应当记录供应商随每次响应返回的标识符。一份说不出自己测的是哪个具体修订版的质量报告，一年后就没人读得懂，而且这种失败是安静的：报告看上去依然权威，描述的却是一个已经不存在的模型。

一个数字每次运行都会漂移的基准测试，必须先解释漂移，其他结论才值得被认真对待。采样温度是最大的那根杠杆：温度为零时，多数供应商确定性地返回概率最大的词元；任何正温度都会注入有意的随机性。一次不钉住、不披露温度的质量评测，测到的与其说是模型，不如说是它自己的噪声。

披露必须是结构化的，而不是脚注。报告顶部应当携带运行时冻结的推理设置：温度、最大输出 token、是否流式、生效的判分器集合。冻结之所以重要，是因为跑完之后再改数据集，绝不能悄悄改写历史；运行开始时拍下的快照才是报告所描述的对象。

Failure Semantics and Error Taxonomy (Part 8)

The distinction between a failed request and an ungradeable answer is the second structural decision. A request that never completed produced no output to judge; a request that completed with nonsense produced output the grader rejected. Collapsing the two makes availability problems look like quality problems, and a pass-rate computed over that collapsed set answers a question nobody asked.

Aggregation policy follows from the taxonomy. Latency percentiles computed over successful requests only, error rate reported separately, and unscored items excluded from quality denominators: each population must be named in the report. Silent population switching, where the denominator shrinks without explanation, is the most common way honest measurements become dishonest reports.

Finally, stop conditions should be loud. A run that halted after the first failure must say so at the top of the report, because a truncated distribution presented without the truncation notice is indistinguishable from a complete one. The cheapest defense is a status line that states samples planned, samples completed, and the reason the run ended.

The credibility of a measurement tool is decided by what it does when things go wrong. A harness that fills failed requests with plausible-looking synthetic numbers produces beautiful reports that are quietly worthless; a harness that reports the failure honestly produces uglier reports that can be trusted. The design rule is absolute: a number in the report must trace back to a real request, or it must not exist.

Error taxonomy is what turns raw failures into information. Rate-limit responses, authentication rejections, malformed streams, context-length overflows, and server crashes are different events with different remedies, and a benchmark that buckets them all as unknown error forces the reader to guess. Classification should happen at the adapter layer, where the provider-specific shapes are known, and travel with the sample as a structured field.

失败语义与错误归类 (Part 8)

"请求失败"与"答案无法判分"的区分，是第二个结构性决定。一个从未完成的请求没有产出可供评判；一个完成了但输出胡言乱语的请求，产出了被判分器拒绝的答案。把两者混为一谈，会让可用性问题看起来像质量问题，而在混合集合上算出的通过率，回答的是一个没有人问过的问题。

聚合策略从分类中自然推出。延迟分位数只对成功请求计算、错误率单独报告、未能判定的条目排除在质量分母之外：每一处统计口径都必须在报告里点明。口径的静默切换——分母在没有解释的情况下变小——是诚实的测量变成不诚实的报告最常见的路径。

最后，停止条件应当大声宣告。一场在首个失败后就中止的运行，必须在报告顶部说明这一点，因为一个被截断的分布，如果不带截断说明，与完整的分布没有区别。最便宜的防线是一行状态：计划样本数、完成样本数、运行结束的原因。

测量工具的可信度，是由它出错时的行为决定的。一个用看起来合理的合成数字填补失败请求的工具，会产出漂亮却悄悄一文不值的报告；一个如实报告失败的工具，产出的报告更难看，却可以信任。设计规则是绝对的：报告里的每个数字要么能追溯到一个真实请求，要么就不该存在。

错误分类是把原始失败变成信息的手段。限流响应、鉴权拒绝、流格式损坏、上下文长度溢出、服务端崩溃，是不同的事件、有不同的对策；把它们统统归进"未知错误"的基准，等于逼读者去猜。分类应当在适配器层完成——那里最清楚各供应商的错误形态——并作为结构化字段随样本一起传递。

Long-Context Behavior and Attention (Part 8)

Output scope control belongs in the harness, not the prompt author hands. Asking a model to summarize two hundred thousand tokens into three bullets produces a cheap response; asking it to list every document produces a long one. Letting the same prompt template carry an adjustable scope instruction separates the cost of input processing from the cost of output generation, which is exactly the split a capacity planner needs.

Token counting for long inputs is where local estimation diverges most from provider accounting. Special tokens, whitespace normalization, and truncation behavior differ per provider, and at two hundred thousand tokens a one percent accounting difference is a two-thousand-token discrepancy on the invoice. Reports should show the locally estimated count and the provider-reported usage side by side.

The failure modes at the long end are quiet. A truncated middle section produces a confident answer about a document the model never effectively saw, and nothing in the response flags the omission. Position-varied probes are the countermeasure: if retrieval accuracy collapses in the middle but holds at the edges, the harness can name the pattern instead of reporting a mean that hides it.

Context windows are advertised as hard numbers, but quality degrades gradually inside the window rather than failing at its edge. Retrieval accuracy for a fact buried in the middle of a long prompt is typically worse than for the same fact at the beginning or end, a pattern strong enough to have a name. Benchmarking long-context behavior therefore requires probes that vary position deliberately, not just length.

Multi-document prompts are the practical carrier for these probes. A prompt built from independent documents with a per-document task at the end lets the harness score each document separately: which positions were retrieved, which were skipped, and whether the boundary between documents confused the segmentation. The same prompt shape doubles as a realistic load for latency and cost measurement, since production prompts rarely consist of one homogeneous blob.

[Document 190]
长上下文行为与注意力 (Part 8)

输出范围控制应当属于工具，而不是提示词作者的手工作业。要求模型把二十万 token 总结成三个要点，产出的是廉价响应；要求它列出每个文档，产出的是长响应。让同一个提示词模板携带可调节的范围指令，就把输入处理的成本与输出生成的成本拆开了——这恰恰是容量规划需要的那个拆分。

长输入的 token 计数是本地估算与供应商记账分歧最大的地方。特殊词元、空白归一化与截断行为因供应商而异；二十万 token 的量级下，百分之一的记账差异就是账单上两千 token 的出入。报告应当把本地估算数与供应商上报的用量并排展示。

长文本尽头的失败模式是安静的。中段被截断后，模型会对一个它实际上从未有效看到过的文档给出自信的回答，而响应中没有任何标记提示这个遗漏。位置可变的探针是对策：如果中段的检索准确率塌陷而两端完好，工具就能点名这个模式，而不是报告一个把它藏起来的平均值。

上下文窗口在宣传里是一个硬数字，但质量是在窗口内部逐渐退化，而不是在边界处突然失效。埋在长提示词中段的事实的检索准确率，通常低于同一个事实放在开头或结尾时的准确率，这个模式稳定到拥有自己的名字。因此对长上下文行为的基准测试，需要的是刻意变化位置的探针，而不只是变化长度。

多文档提示词是承载这些探针的实用形态。用相互独立的文档、末尾附一个逐文档任务来构造提示词，工具就能对每个文档单独计分：哪些位置被检索到了、哪些被跳过、文档边界是否干扰了切分。同一个提示词形状还能兼任延迟与成本测量的真实负载，因为生产环境的提示词很少是一整块同质文本。

Dataset Import and Row-Level Validation (Part 8)

Identifier discipline keeps histories auditable. If rows can share an id, a report that references question twelve is ambiguous, and joining an old run against the current dataset produces nonsense. Enforcing uniqueness at import costs one hash set; retrofitting auditability onto a dataset with duplicate ids costs a migration and an apology.

Field-level types should be declared, not inferred. A reference answer that is sometimes a string and sometimes a number forces every downstream consumer to guess, and the guesses will disagree. The import schema declares the type per field, the validator enforces it per row, and the grader can then trust what it reads.

Versioning closes the loop. Datasets evolve: questions are reworded, references are corrected, rows are added. A run that stores a frozen snapshot of the questions it measured stays reproducible after the live dataset moves on, and the snapshot should record which version of the dataset it was taken from. The alternative is reports that cannot be reproduced by their own author.

An evaluation is only as good as its dataset, and most dataset damage happens at import time. A file that parses cleanly can still contain rows with empty references, answers in the wrong type, or duplicate identifiers, and every one of those rows becomes a grading dispute later. Row-level validation at the boundary, with a per-line report, is the cheapest place to catch all of it.

The validation report should be reject-with-reasons, not accept-with-warnings. A row that fails validation must never be silently dropped or silently coerced: the importer returns the line number, the field, and the reason, and the run either proceeds without the rejected rows or does not proceed at all. Silent coercion is worse than silent dropping, because the data appears to be what it is not.

数据集导入与逐行校验 (Part 8)

标识符纪律让历史可审计。如果不同的行可以共用一个 id，那么"第 12 题判错了"这句话就是有歧义的，把一次旧运行与当前数据集做关联会得出毫无意义的结论。在导入时强制唯一性只花一个哈希集合；而在 id 重复的数据集上事后补审计，要花一次迁移外加一句道歉。

字段类型应当声明，而不是推断。一个有时是字符串、有时是数字的参考答案，会逼每个下游消费者去猜，而猜测的结果互不一致。导入 schema 为每个字段声明类型，校验器逐行执行，判分器从此可以信任它读到的内容。

版本管理为整个流程收尾。数据集会演化：题目被改写、参考答案被修正、行被添加。一次运行如果存储了它所测题目的冻结快照，在活数据集继续演化之后依然可复现，而且快照应当记录它取自数据集的哪个版本。另一条路的尽头，是连作者自己都无法复现的报告。

评测的上限由数据集决定，而数据集的损伤大多发生在导入时。一个解析无误的文件，仍可能包含参考答案为空的行、类型错误的答案、重复的标识符，每一行都会在日后变成一场判分争议。在边界处做逐行校验并给出带行号的报告，是拦截这一切成本最低的位置。

校验报告应当是"拒绝并说明理由"，而不是"接受并附警告"。校验失败的行绝不能被悄悄丢弃或悄悄修正：导入器返回行号、字段与原因，运行要么在剔除这些行之后继续，要么干脆不继续。静默修正比静默丢弃更糟，因为数据看起来已经不是它本来的样子。

Latency Measurement in API Benchmarks (Part 9)

Warmup iterations exist because the first request to a fresh endpoint pays for TLS negotiation, connection pooling, and occasionally a cold model instance. Discarding the first few samples is standard practice, but the harness should record how many were discarded, because a benchmark that hides its warmup policy is difficult to compare against one that does not.

Finally, wall-clock timing on a busy machine is noisy. The generator process should pin its own scheduling as far as the runtime allows, avoid running other work in parallel, and report the machine load alongside the results. Numbers produced on a laptop while a build is running are not comparable with numbers produced on an idle server, and honest reports say so.

Latency in an LLM API is not a single number. Time to first token and time to last token describe different layers of the serving stack, and a benchmark that collapses them into one mean throws away the information that operators actually need. A gateway that buffers the entire response before forwarding will look identical to a streaming endpoint at the aggregate level, while feeling completely different to a user watching the screen.

A measurement harness therefore has to separate connection setup, queueing, inference, and stream drain. Each request should record when the TCP connection opened, when the request body was written, when the first byte of the response arrived, and when the stream closed. From these raw timestamps every derived metric, including p50 and p99 figures, can be recomputed later without re-running the workload.

Retries deserve explicit accounting. A provider that silently retries a failed stream behind the same request will report a latency distribution that hides the failure, and a client-side retry policy will double-count the attempt. The harness should mark the retry in the sample rather than folding it into a single blended number, so the report can show both the success-path latency and the cost of recovering from errors.

API 基准测试中的延迟测量 (Part 9)

预热迭代的存在，是因为打到新端点的第一个请求要支付 TLS 握手、连接池初始化，偶尔还有冷启动的模型实例。丢弃前几个样本是通行做法，但工具必须记录丢弃了多少个：一个不披露预热策略的基准，是无法与披露了的基准相互比较的。

最后，繁忙机器上的墙钟时间充满噪声。压测进程应尽量固定自身的调度，避免与其他工作并行，并把机器负载与结果一同报告。笔记本在跑构建的同时测出来的数字，与空闲服务器上测出来的数字没有可比性，诚实的报告会把这一点写明白。

大模型 API 的延迟从来不是单一数字。首字延迟与尾字延迟描述的是服务栈的不同层面，把两者折叠成一个平均值的基准测试，丢掉的恰恰是运维人员最需要的信息。一个在转发前缓冲完整响应的网关，在聚合指标上与流式端点看不出差别，但对于盯着屏幕等首字的用户来说，体验完全不同。

因此测量工具必须把连接建立、排队、推理与流式收尾分开记录。每个请求都应记录 TCP 连接打开的时刻、请求体写完的时刻、响应首字节到达的时刻，以及流关闭的时刻。有了这些原始时间戳，包括 p50、p99 在内的所有派生指标都可以事后重新计算，而不必重跑整个负载。

重试需要显式记账。供应商在同一请求背后悄悄重试失败的流，会报告出一个掩盖失败的延迟分布；客户端侧的重试策略则会让一次尝试被统计两次。测量工具应当把重试标记在样本里，而不是混进一个笼统的数字，这样报告才能同时呈现成功路径的延迟与从错误中恢复的代价。

[Document 195]
Token Accounting and Cost Estimation (Part 9)

Per-model price configuration belongs in versioned storage, not in a config file someone edits by hand. Prices change, and a report that cannot say which price table produced its cost column is not auditable. The report should embed the unit prices alongside the totals, so a reader can recompute the arithmetic with a calculator and confirm it.

Rounding is a small detail with a visible footprint. Summing unrounded per-request costs and rounding only at the end gives a different total than rounding each row first, and finance teams notice. The platform should round once, at presentation time, and keep full precision in the stored samples.

Every billing dispute with a model provider starts with a disagreement about token counts. The number a client computes locally with an offline tokenizer will drift from the number in the usage field of the response, because the server may normalize whitespace, count tool-call envelopes, or use a newer tokenizer revision. A benchmark platform that wants credible cost numbers has to decide which side of that disagreement it reports, and say so in the documentation.

Cost estimation before a run is a different problem from cost accounting after it. Before the run, the platform only knows the prompt length and configured output limits, so the estimate is a bound: the guaranteed floor if the model answers tersely, and the ceiling if it rambles to the limit. Presenting a single pre-run number without that interval invites users to treat a guess as a promise.

Tiered pricing makes the arithmetic worse. Many providers charge less for cached input tokens than for fresh ones, which means the same workload can cost half as much on the second run. A cost model that wants to reflect reality needs a separate rate per token class, and the workload configuration needs a way to express the expected cache-hit ratio, because that ratio, not the raw prompt length, often dominates the bill.

Token 计量与成本预估 (Part 9)

每模型的价格配置应当放进带版本管理的存储，而不是一个有人手工编辑的配置文件。价格会变，一份说不出自己用的是哪张价格表的报告，谈不上可审计。报告应当把单价与总额一起嵌入，读者拿计算器就能复核这笔账。

舍入是个小细节，却有显眼的痕迹。先累加未舍入的每请求成本、最后统一舍入，与逐行先舍入再累加，会得到不同的总额，财务团队会注意到。平台应当只在展示时舍入一次，存储的样本里保留完整精度。

与模型供应商的每一次账单争议，都始于对 token 数量的分歧。客户端用离线分词器算出的数字，与响应 usage 字段里的数字会有出入：服务端可能做了空白归一化、把工具调用的信封也算进去，或者用了更新版本的分词器。想要让成本数字可信的评测平台，必须决定自己报告分歧的哪一边，并把它写进文档。

跑前预估与跑后核算是两个不同的问题。跑之前，平台只知道提示词长度和配置的输出上限，所以预估只能是一个区间：模型答得简短时的保底值，与它一路写到上限时的封顶值。给出一个不带区间的单一预估数字，等于把猜测包装成承诺。

阶梯定价让算术更复杂。很多供应商对缓存命中的输入 token 收费更低，同样的负载第二次跑可能只花一半的钱。想反映现实的成本模型需要为每一类 token 单独立价，负载配置也需要能表达预期的缓存命中率——因为主导账单的往往不是提示词长度，而是这个比例。

Prompt Caching and Prefix Reuse (Part 9)

The shared-prefix pattern also has a failure mode worth measuring: prompts that share a prefix only up to a diverging middle section. Systems differ in how they handle partial overlap, and a workload built from a common system prompt followed by per-task bodies will expose that boundary. Reporting per-request cache ratios alongside the aggregate tells you where the boundary sits.

Deterministic replay is the final requirement. If the harness shuffles content between runs, the hit ratio becomes an accident of ordering rather than a property of the workload. Fixing the request order and recording it in the report turns cache behavior from an anecdote into a reproducible number.

Prefix caching changes the economics of repeated workloads. When a provider recognizes that an incoming request shares a long prefix with a recent one, it can skip recomputing the attention keys for that prefix and charge a reduced rate for the cached portion. The mechanism is invisible at the protocol level: the request looks the same whether or not the cache fires, and the only evidence is a usage breakdown in the response.

That invisibility is why benchmark suites treat cache behavior as something to be controlled rather than observed. A workload can pin the hit ratio by design: run the first iteration with a unique suffix to prime the cache, then replay with identical prefixes to harvest the discount. Between providers the accounting differs, some report cached tokens explicitly and some only show a cheaper total, so the harness has to normalize both shapes into one comparable field.

TTL is the quiet variable. A cache entry may expire in seconds or minutes depending on provider and load, and a benchmark that assumes hits will measure nothing at all if the gap between iterations outlasts the entry. Spacing matters as much as content: two identical requests fifty milliseconds apart and two identical requests five minutes apart are experiments on different systems.
